Pre-conditions: Logged in to app.ptdev.xyz as QA Admin S1.
Test Steps: 1. File > Administration > Job Card Preferences. 2. In Search settings type "decimal". 3. Section Accuracy: note Time Decimal Accuracy (dev: 4). 4. Search "round": section Time Rounding: note Time Rounding at Transfer to Job Cards [Minutes] (dev: 15) and that Round Job Change is OFF. Do NOT use Preferences > Piece Rate / Piece Per Hour / Piece Decimal Accuracy: those are piece settings, not hours.
Expected Result: Time Decimal Accuracy is visible (2, 3 or 4). Write it down so it can be restored in E6-06. Because transfer rounds punches to 15 minutes, keep the Time In and Time Out on quarter hours; the job switches (08:40, 11:20) are not rounded while Round Job Change is off.

Test Scenario: Seed an 8-hour day split into three equal job segments
Pre-conditions: E6-00 done. Day D within the last 21 days with no other punches for the employee.
Test Data: Day D; one employee with an hourly rate (e.g. 145 Sergio Castillo); three jobs with an hourly rate: Job A, Job B, Job C
Test Steps: 1. Input > Crew Time In: crew of the employee, date D, time 06:00, Job A, Save. 2. Input > Crew Time In: same crew, date D, time 08:40, Job B, Save. 3. Input > Crew Time In: same crew, date D, time 11:20, Job C, Save. 4. Input > Crew Time Out: same crew, date D, time 14:00, Save. No meal.
Expected Result: Four punches on D for the employee: 06:00, 08:40, 11:20 (job switches) and 14:00 (out). Each segment is 2 h 40 m = 160 minutes, so the day is exactly 480 minutes = 8 hours. 160 minutes is 2.6666... hours, a repeating decimal.
Linked AC: E6 precondition: a day whose minutes convert to a repeating decimal

Test Steps: 1. Transfer to Job Cards. 2. Dates = D to D. 3. Employee = the employee. 4. Click Analyze Transfer Candidates. 5. Open the Job Cards tab.
Expected Result: Blocking 0 for the employee. The Job Cards preview lists exactly 3 job cards for the employee (Job A 06:00-08:40, Job B 08:40-11:20, Job C 11:20-14:00). Gross/Net total for the employee = 8.

Test Scenario: Transfer at precision 2 and check the correction
Pre-conditions: E6-02 done. Job Card Preferences > Accuracy > Time Decimal Accuracy set to 2 and Saved.
Test Steps: 1. Transfer to Job Cards: tick only the employee's rows. 2. Transfer Selected > Transfer. 3. View > Job Cards: date D, Employee = the employee, Apply. 4. Read Gross Time and Net Time of each card in time order, and the Totals bar.
Expected Result: Card 1 = 2.67, Card 2 = 2.67, Card 3 (the LAST card) = 2.66. Sum = 8.00 exactly, never 8.01 or 7.99. The correction (-0.01) is on the last card only.
Linked AC: E6 step 2: small correction applied to the last job card

Pre-conditions: E6-03 done. View > Job Cards > Reverse the transfer of day D (File > Administration > Restore or Reverse > Reverse Transfer to Job Cards). Time Decimal Accuracy set to 3 and Saved.
Test Steps: 1. Transfer the employee's rows again (as E6-03). 2. View > Job Cards: date D, the employee, Apply. 3. Read each card and the Totals bar.
Expected Result: Card 1 = 2.667, Card 2 = 2.667, Card 3 = 2.666. Sum = 8.000 exactly. Correction on the last card.

Pre-conditions: E6-04 done. Reverse the transfer of day D again. Time Decimal Accuracy set to 4 and Saved.
Test Steps: 1. Transfer the employee's rows again. 2. View > Job Cards: date D, the employee, Apply. 3. Read each card and the Totals bar.
Expected Result: Card 1 = 2.6667, Card 2 = 2.6667, Card 3 = 2.6666. Sum = 8.0000 exactly. Correction on the last card.

Test Steps: 1. File > Administration > Job Card Preferences. 2. Search "decimal", set Time Decimal Accuracy back to the value from E6-00. 3. Save.
Expected Result: The preference shows its original value.

Test Steps: 1. Transfer at precision 2. 2. View > Job Cards: read each card.
Expected Result: Card 1 = 1.33, Card 2 = 3.33, Card 3 = 3.34. Sum = 8.00. The correction (+0.01) is on the last card, not spread or dropped.
Linked AC: E6 variation: multiple jobs in a day
